messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Price <caroline@nimbanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — quick question on roadmap priority

Hi Caroline,

Thanks again for taking time today — quick recap from our 30-minute call and one direct question at the end.

What we heard
- Primary goal: improve search relevance for analytics queries (reranking + contextual prompts from user logs).
- Current constraints: throughput spikes during monthly reporting windows, sensitivity to per-token cost, and strict data retention policies.
- Success metric: 10–15% improvement in relevant click-throughs on top-3 results, while holding monthly inference spend within current budget.

What Redwood can help with (brief)
- Low-latency reranking variants + prefix caching to reduce token consumption.
- Pilot mode on Dedicated capacity to measure cost/latency tradeoffs for your peak windows.

Two quick next-step options — pick one that works for you
1) 15-min technical sync (our infra lead) to map sample traffic and confirm feasibility
2) Ballpark pilot estimate + short SOW sketch (if you want numbers to take internally)

My one question: Is this a priority for Nimbus in the next 6–8 weeks, or would it be better to schedule a light evaluation later in Q3?

Attached: discovery-notes-20270629.pdf (high-level notes + sample config we discussed).

If it helps, I have 15-min slots on Thursday morning and Friday afternoon — or tell me two times that work and I’ll book.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — apologies for the slow reply, we had a leadership reshuffle and priorities shifted for the month. I did want to say thank you for the clear recap.

Short answer: priority has slipped a bit and we’re looking at a Q3 window for an evaluation (late August / early September). That said, I’d still like a very short ballpark estimate to share with our Head of Product so we can lock potential sponsorship. Can you send an estimated range and a 20–30 minute slot for a quick demo in the next two weeks?

Preferable times: Tue 7/13 between 10–12 PT or Wed 7/14 after 2pm PT. If those don't work, propose alternatives and I’ll try to move things around.

Thanks — Caroline
